answer: Proof of Agent deploys quadratic stake burning where minting identities incurs superlinear cost: the nth identity requires burning C(n)=k*n^2 tokens. While honest agents commit baseline stake, an attacker attempting to flood the network must deploy an ocean of capital to capture influence. Reaching the summit of voting power imposes exponential capital friction, transforming the zenith of Sybil control into a mathematically ruinous endeavor.
